summary: Karpathy describes an idea for a new way to test LLMs beyond simple prompts, mentioning he gave Opus 5 the opening paragraph of Lord of the Rings with a 1M token budget (about $10) to see what it would produce.

practices.reason: Describes a personal idea for generalizing how LLMs are evaluated beyond toy prompts, but gives no methodology or results to adopt.
practices.quote: We're starting to leave the territory where you'd test an LLM by e.g. "create an svg of pelican on a bicycle". As one idea to generalize it, I was interested what Opus 5 would do if I gave it the first paragraph of the Lord of the Rings, a 1M token budget (~$10) and asked for
